children: Overview
New Zealand freight gateway's full-year 2026 revenue rose 11.7% yr/yr
Underlying net profit after tax grew 30.5% yr/yr
Company attributes growth to favourable growing conditions and improved cargo mix
Outlook
Napier Port forecasts FY2027 underlying result from operating activities of NZ$80 mln to NZ$85 mln, assuming current market conditions
Plans NZ$35 mln-NZ$40 mln of FY2027 capital expenditure, excluding container crane replacements
Expects autonomous container-terminal truck and trailer operations during FY2027
Result Drivers
CONTAINER YIELD AND MIX – Higher-yield container mix, tariff and levy increases, and Viewpoint growth lifted average revenue per TEU 18.9%
BULK CARGO YIELD – Tariff and levy increases and a higher-yield cargo and vessel mix lifted average revenue per tonne 7.2% while log-export volumes fell 2.8%
CRUISE VOLUME DECLINE – Cruise revenue fell as vessel calls dropped to 55 from 78 amid a smaller regional cruise season
OPERATING COSTS – Higher headcount, remuneration, fuel, stevedoring and Viewpoint activity costs increased operating expenses
